title: Nooks in every walkable outdoor place
caption: Small places off the walks, with a few props each, kept for later secrets, encounters and collectibles: shrines, drinks machines, a lookout, a smoking corner, a back alley, benches tucked behind hedges and under pines. Nothing is placed in them yet. Each picture has Eric standing at the nook's named spot (docs/game/places.md, "Nooks").

sections.title: Station forecourt
sections.caption: The recess in front of the staff gate, between the court's north bed and head office's corner: a bike against the bed, a pot and an umbrella stand.

sections.title: Fountain plaza
sections.caption: The bay off the cross walk is now walkable, a pot at its end; a roadside shrine (hokora, torii, two stone lanterns) on the lawn west of the cross walk, by the ginkgo.

sections.title: Shop street and seafront
sections.caption: A shrine on the lawn past the arcade's west mouth; the shops' back in the middle alley (crates of empties, an outdoor unit, a bike); a bench under the pines through a new gap in the lookout's east rail.

sections.title: East lane
sections.caption: A shrine through a gap in the north street's west verge, between two zelkovas; a bench on the footpath behind the barber's, off the dorm street, bollards where the path is closed.

sections.title: East coast
sections.caption: A lookout with a coin telescope where the coast walk turns inland, out to the sea wall; a shrine on the lawn south of the walk inland.

sections.title: Gym and pool
sections.caption: Drinks machines through a gap in the courts walk's hedge, between the pool and the courts; a bench behind a hedge on the grass by the pool walk.

sections.title: Harbour
sections.caption: The supply pier's end with bollards, a life ring, rope and a fisherman's stool; the warehouse's back with its outdoor units and crates of empties; a lookout with a coin telescope and a bench at the ferry pier's end.

sections.title: Office street
sections.caption: A smoking corner behind frosted screens in the gap between Amakawa Electric and Amakawa Trading; drinks machines on Amakawa Life's forecourt.
